content: ESA - Dancing dust devils trace raging winds on Mars Science & Exploration Dancing dust devils trace raging winds on Mars 08/10/2025 11083 views 62 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Mars Express In brief Combing through 20 years of images from the European Space Agency’s Mars Express and ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter spacecraft, scientists have tracked 1039 tornado-like whirlwinds to reveal how dust is lifted into the air and swept around Mars’s surface. Published today in Science Advances , their findings – including that the strongest winds on Mars blow much faster than we thought – give us a much clearer picture of the Red Planet’s weather and climate.
